name: Parlor OS season tracks
license: Original. Generated in code by src/game/parlorMusic.ts. No samples, no recordings, no audio files.
method: Each track is a short loop from a seeded pattern generator. Every bar holds a chord pad (three notes, one octave down), plays a bass note on beats one and three, and adds a sparse lead chosen from the season's scale. Voices are Web Audio oscillators with a short exponential envelope. The same seed gives the same notes.
